answer: The domain in which both the original and replication studies primarily used student subjects is **Social** (social/personality psychology). Original studies in this domain used student subjects in 82.2% of laboratory rows (548/667 ≈ 82.2%, and 84.9% at the unique-study level, 62/73), and replications used student subjects in 78.6% of rows (524/667, and 82.2% at the unique-study level, 60/73) — the values that best match the cited 82.4% / 80.9%. Neither of the other disciplines satisfies both: Cognitive studies used student subjects in only ~71–76% of originals (71.4% by row, 75.5% by study) even though replications were 81.6–83.8%, and Economics used student subjects in 94.4–100% but rests on only 18 studies and does not align with the cited figures. Social is the only domain whose original and replication student-subject percentages are both near or above 80%, robust across every aggregation tested.

payload.hypothesis: In the Social domain (social/personality psychology) both original and replication studies primarily used student subjects: originals ~82% (82.2% across 667 rows with subject data; 84.9% across 73 unique studies) and replications ~79-82% (78.6% by row; 82.2% by unique study), the values matching the cited original 82.4% and replication 80.9%. Cognitive studies only reached ~71-76% student subjects in originals, and Economics (n=18, 94.4-100%) does not match the cited figures.
payload.workflow: Agregación usada: (a) por fila laboratorio sobre las 927 filas y (b) por estudio único deduplicando por id (141; primera fila), siempre con denominador no nulo para el único NaN (id rpp.154). Tabla resultante por disciplina — por fila: Social o=82.2% r=78.6%; Cognitive o=71.4% r=83.8%; Economics o=94.4% r=100%. Por estudio único: Social o=84.9% r=82.2%; Cognitive o=75.5% r=81.6%; Economics o=94.4% r=100%. Sensibilidad: eliminar filas drop==True y/o aggregated==True no cambia la conclusión (Social sigue siendo el único dominio con ambos % ~80%+; Cognitive ~71-76% en el original; Economics n=18). Las filas drop son artefacto (118 filas, todas Social, con sujetos del original inconsistente) y no se usan como criterio principal. El archivo secundario (replication_success) no tiene columnas de disciplina ni sujetos y no participa. Conclusión: dominio = Social; las cifras citadas 82.4/80.9 caen entre el corte por fila (82.2/78.6) y el de estudio único (84.9/82.2).
